{{dablink|For other uses of the words "gold" and "heaven," see [[Gold]] and [[Heaven]].}}
'''The Golden Crown of Heaven''' is a poor inn located in the [[Rahad]] district of the city of [[Ebou Dar]]. The grandiose name seems out of keeping with its dilapidated appearance and dubious clientele.
